comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
The exact conditions for this to appear at your colony are covered here:

Company Colony

Just click on your region, and consult the charts. Certain buildings affect your colony's score in agriculture and the like, so getting Natal Indigo to appear is (seemingly) a very precise science. It apparently can only be bought in a company colony at the Wares Market building, and as it's important for a Memorial Album recipe new to GAMA, will probably be in slightly higher demand than it used to be.
